text: A contract deployed with plain CREATE gets an address derived from the deployer and its transaction nonce. The moment nonces diverge across chains, the same contract lands at different addresses on each one.
CREATE2 derives an address from the deployer, a salt, and the init code — not the nonce. Same deployer, same salt, same bytecode on two chains produces the same address on both.
GitHub Actions' strategy matrix runs the same job once per entry in a list. Each chain runs as its own isolated job in parallel, against its own named RPC endpoint.

Multisig discipline doesn't collapse into one approval for every chain. Each chain's deployment needs its own confirmations from that chain's Safe — five chains means five separate confirmation flows.
That closes Chapter 3 — testnets, deploy scripts, verification, proxies, multisig control, and multi-chain, all as one coherent deployment discipline, not six separate habits.
